# GitHub Discussions Setup Guide

Copy-paste these when setting up GitHub Discussions.

---

## Category Descriptions

| Category | Format | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| **Announcements** | Announcement | Project updates and releases |
| **Pentest Results** | Open-ended | Share your session reports |
| **Q&A** | Question/Answer | Get help from the community |
| **Ideas** | Open-ended | Suggest new features |

---

## Welcome Post (Announcements - Pin this)

### Title:
```
Welcome to VibeHackAI Discussions
```

### Body:
```markdown
Welcome to the VibeHackAI community!

## How to Contribute Feedback

1. Run your pentest session with VibeHackAI
2. At the end, a report is generated automatically
3. Paste it in **Pentest Results** or [Issues](https://github.com/cawa102/VibeHackAI/issues/new?template=pentest_feedback.md)

That's it. Your report contains everything we need to improve VibeHackAI.

## Other Categories

| Category | Use For |
|----------|---------|
| **Q&A** | Questions about setup or usage |
| **Ideas** | Feature suggestions |
```

## Pentest Results (Pin this)

### Title:
```
How to Submit Your Report
```

### Body:
```markdown
## Submit in 2 Steps

1. **Run VibeHackAI** → Complete your session
2. **Paste the report** → That's it

Reports are auto-generated with:
- Session summary
- Phases completed
- Findings
- AI interaction stats
- Anonymized metadata

**Note:** Reports are auto-sanitized, but please verify no sensitive data remains before posting.
```

```markdown
## FAQ

**Q: Which MCP servers are supported?**
A: Nmap, Shodan, Burp Suite, Metasploit, Kali, Snyk, CVE-Search, GitHub, GitLab, and more.

**Q: Is this production-ready?**
A: VibeHackAI is v0.1.0 (early development). Verify findings manually.
```
